points.K5: 玻璃板更耐热、分得更好
points.K16: 滴管拉制要跟有经验的人学
points.K22: 染色是破坏性的：先看紫外

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上有一块大玻璃板、一盏燃气灯和几瓶显色剂，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a large glass plate, an unlit gas burner and a few reagent jars with blank labels, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲薄层色谱的进阶技巧。

shots.scene: 玻璃刀、细毛细管、显色瓶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a glass cutter, a thin glass capillary, and a reagent jar with a plate dipping in. No people.
shots.narration: 切板、拉管、染色，三样本领。

shots.scene: 阿杰进了课题组，看着一块大玻璃板和一盒粗毛细管发愁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a research lab looks at a large glass plate and a box of thick capillaries, puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰进了课题组，薄层板要自己切。

shots.scene: 阿杰的板在紫外灯下什么都看不见，他挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a plate under a UV lamp and sees nothing on it; he scratches his head.
shots.narration: 紫外灯下看不到斑点，怎么办？

shots.scene: 小研拿着玻璃刀和一瓶显色剂走过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over holding a glass cutter and a reagent jar.
shots.narration: 小研说：这几样手艺，研究室天天用。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and nods.
shots.narration: 我们一样一样来学。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在研究实验室的台面旁，举起一块玻璃薄层板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a research lab bench and holds up a glass-backed thin plate.
shots.narration: 在研究实验室，这些技巧很常用。

shots.scene: 紫外灯和显色板两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a UV lamp and a stained plate with dark spots. No people.
shots.narration: 除了紫外灯，还要会用显色剂。

shots.scene: 五个基础步骤图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Five basic step icons light up one by one: a jar, a pencil line, a plate in a jar, a lamp, a ruler. No people.
shots.narration: 基础篇学了展开、点样、显色和计算。

shots.scene: 三张卡片：大板切小板、毛细管变细、板子浸入瓶中
shots.prompt_en: Three cards: a big plate divided into small ones, a capillary narrowing in the middle, a plate dipping into a jar. No people.
shots.narration: 这次学切板、拉管和染色。

shots.scene: 一叠塑料背衬板和一把剪刀
shots.prompt_en: A stack of plastic-backed thin plates and a pair of scissors. No people.
shots.narration: 塑料板便宜，大多已经切好。

shots.scene: 剪刀剪开塑料板
shots.prompt_en: Scissors cut a plastic-backed plate into a smaller piece. No people.
shots.narration: 没切好，用剪刀剪就行。

shots.section_title: 玻璃板更耐热、分得更好
shots.scene: 玻璃板在热源上方不变形，塑料板卷曲
shots.prompt_en: A glass-backed plate stays flat above a heat icon while a plastic plate curls up. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃板更耐热，染色加热不怕。
overlay: 玻璃板更耐热、分得更好

shots.section_title: 玻璃板更耐热、分得更好
shots.scene: 玻璃板上的斑点更清晰
shots.prompt_en: A glass plate with sharp, well-separated spots, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 分离效果也常常更好。

shots.scene: 一块大方形玻璃板，边上标尺寸
shots.prompt_en: A large square glass plate with a measuring arrow along one edge. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃板通常买来是大方板。

shots.scene: 大板分成许多小格
shots.prompt_en: The large plate is divided by lines into many small rectangles. No people.
shots.narration: 一块大板，能切出几十块小板。

shots.scene: 一把玻璃刀特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a glass cutter with an orange handle and a small cutting wheel. No people.
shots.narration: 切玻璃是门手艺，要多练。

shots.scene: 玻璃刀在玻璃上划出一道细痕
shots.prompt_en: The glass cutter scores a thin straight line on the glass. No people.
shots.narration: 先用玻璃刀划痕，再沿线掰断。

shots.scene: 大板上画出三条等距线
shots.prompt_en: Three evenly spaced lines drawn across the large plate. No people.
shots.narration: 先切三刀，分成四根长条。

shots.scene: 小研穿着T恤，徒手把大板涂层面朝下放在干净台面上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a T-shirt and bare-handed, lays the large plate coated side down on a clean dry bench.
shots.narration: 涂层面朝下，放在干净干燥的台面。

shots.scene: 直尺和铅笔在板背面标线
shots.prompt_en: A ruler and a pencil mark cutting lines on the back of the plate. No people.
shots.narration: 用铅笔和直尺标好切线。

shots.scene: 玻璃刀沿直尺一次划过
shots.prompt_en: The glass cutter is drawn along the ruler in one firm sweep. No people.
shots.narration: 用力一次划过。

shots.scene: 来回反复划的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cutter scoring the same line back and forth many times, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 反复划，反而掰不直。

shots.scene: 小研把划痕对准台边，向下轻压掰断
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lines up the score with the bench edge and presses down to snap the glass cleanly.
shots.narration: 划痕对准台边，一压就断。

shots.scene: 长条再切成一块块小板，整齐码放
shots.prompt_en: A long strip is cut into small plates that are stacked neatly in a box. No people.
shots.narration: 长条再切成小板，备足库存。

shots.scene: 粗细两支毛细管和它们点出的斑点
shots.prompt_en: A thick capillary and a thin capillary, each above the spot it makes: a big spot and a tiny spot. No people.
shots.narration: 自拉的点样管更细，斑点更小。

shots.scene: 一块板上整齐排着很多小斑点
shots.prompt_en: One plate with many small spots in a neat row, and a coin icon. No people.
shots.narration: 分得更清，一块板点得更多，更省。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里，把毛细管中部放在燃气灯蓝色火焰上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and a lab coat, holds the middle of a glass capillary in the blue flame of a gas burner inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 毛细管中部放进蓝色火焰。

shots.scene: 毛细管中部发红变软的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the middle of the capillary glowing and softening. No people.
shots.narration: 加热到中间开始变软。

shots.scene: 毛细管移出火焰，两手向外拉，中间变细
shots.prompt_en: The capillary is taken out of the flame and pulled apart gently, the middle stretching thin. No people.
shots.narration: 移出火焰，向两端拉。

shots.scene: 太冷拉不动和软塌下垂两个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a stiff capillary that will not stretch, and a sagging droopy one. No people.
shots.narration: 太冷拉不动，烧太久就软塌了。

shots.scene: 细处掰断，得到两支细尖点样管
shots.prompt_en: The thin middle is snapped, giving two fine-tipped spotters. No people.
shots.narration: 从中间掰断，得到两支点样管。

shots.section_title: 滴管拉制要跟有经验的人学
shots.scene: 一支滴管变成一排细点样管的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of one glass dropper turning into a row of many thin spotters. No people.
shots.narration: 用滴管也能拉出几十支。
overlay: 滴管拉制要跟有经验的人学

shots.section_title: 滴管拉制要跟有经验的人学
shots.scene: 老周在旁边指导小研
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands beside the female graduate student and guides her at the fume hood.
shots.narration: 这种方法有风险，要跟有经验的人学。

shots.scene: 铺锡箔的台面上有紫外灯、几瓶显色剂、纸巾和热风枪
shots.prompt_en: A foil-covered bench with a UV lamp, several reagent jars with blank labels, paper towels and a heat gun on a stand. No people.
shots.narration: 显色台：紫外灯、显色剂、纸巾。

shots.scene: 热风枪和电热板两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a heat gun and a hot plate. No people.
shots.narration: 再加一个热风枪或电热板。

shots.scene: 展开后的板放在纸巾上，溶剂蒸气图标飘散
shots.prompt_en: A developed plate rests on a paper towel while faint solvent vapor icons drift away. No people.
shots.narration: 先照常点样展开，让溶剂挥发干。

shots.scene: 小研在铺着锡箔的显色台上，用镊子把板浸入显色剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, dips the plate into a reagent jar with tweezers at a foil-covered staining bench.
shots.narration: 把板浸入显色剂。

shots.scene: 板提起，液滴流回瓶中；背面在纸巾上擦干
shots.prompt_en: The plate is lifted so drops run back into the jar, then its back is wiped on a paper towel. No people.
shots.narration: 余液流回瓶中，背面在纸巾上擦干。

shots.scene: 板上还看不到斑点，问号图标
shots.prompt_en: A plate with no visible spots yet, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 还没斑点？别着急，要加热。

shots.scene: 镊子夹板在热风枪出风口上方，斑点渐渐出现
shots.prompt_en: Tweezers hold the plate just above the nozzle of a heat gun; dark spots slowly appear. No people.
shots.narration: 板放在热风口上方，看着斑点出现。

shots.scene: 整块板烤成黑色，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A plate burnt completely dark, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 加热太久，整块板会发黑。

shots.scene: 三块染色板，颜色各不相同
shots.prompt_en: Three stained plates with different background colors and spots. No people.
shots.narration: 常用显色剂有好几种。

shots.section_title: 染色是破坏性的：先看紫外
shots.scene: 斑点被显色剂永久改变的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a spot changing permanently after staining, with a one-way arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 染色会和化合物不可逆地反应。
overlay: 染色是破坏性的：先看紫外

shots.section_title: 染色是破坏性的：先看紫外
shots.scene: 先紫外灯、后显色瓶的顺序箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow showing the order: first a UV lamp icon, then a reagent jar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 所以染色前，一定先看紫外。

shots.scene: 同一化合物在三种显色剂里，只有一种显色
shots.prompt_en: The same spot on three plates with different stains; only one plate shows the spot, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 不是每种化合物都能被每种剂显色。

shots.scene: 小研在本子上记下哪种显色剂有效
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student notes which stain worked in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 多试几种，找到合适的。

shots.scene: 欣欣手捧空白讲义
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a thick blank lab manual.
shots.narration: 演示只是预习，讲义一定要读。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现玻璃板和玻璃刀图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a glass plate and a glass cutter.
shots.narration: 涂层朝下，一次划透，台边掰断。

shots.scene: 火焰和细毛细管图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blue flame and a thin drawn capillary. No people.
shots.narration: 火中软化，移出拉伸，中间掰断。

shots.scene: 紫外灯在前、显色瓶在后的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a UV lamp followed by an arrow to a stain jar. No people.
shots.narration: 先看紫外，再浸染加热。

shots.scene: 三块颜色不同的染色板图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of three stained plates in different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 显不出来，就多换几种显色剂。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一块显色清晰的玻璃板，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a glass plate with clearly stained spots and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 手艺多练习，下次见！
